product_metadata.title: Bliss Luxury Combed Cotton Bath Towels - 27" x 54" Standard Size Premium Quality Bath Sheet - 650 GSM - Soft, Absorbent (Mocha)
features: AMAZINGLY ABSORBENT - THE WAY A TOWEL SHOULD BE: Created for maximum water absorbency. A heavy weight, heavy duty towel with 650 GSM and a tight knit weave with higher picks per inch (PPI) than other towels available on the market.

SO SOFT, YOU WOULD WRAP YOUR BABY IN IT: 100% ringspun combed cotton is ultra soft on even the most sensitive skin. Designed to retain its softness and absorbency after years of wash and dry cycles. Available in 3 plush colors: Wisteria, Biscuit & Grey.

PREMIUM HOTEL & SPA TOWELS: Bumble believes everyone deserves the same high quality bath towels that upscale hotels and exclusive spas use - without the premium price tag. Indulge yourself every time you shower, without leaving your home.

BONUS CANVAS LAUNDRY BAG INCLUDED: Your new Bliss Bath Towels by Bumble will arrive at your door wrapped in our signature elegant canvas carry bag that can be used again and again. Take your towels with you to the pool, beach, and even the gym.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: We’re so sure you’re going to adore your new Bliss Bath Towels that we’re extending our exclusive guarantee. If you don't find our towels the best value at the the best price, you can return them with no questions asked.
